source: Round-10 finding: process tasks (T-43/46/47) cite docs not §; the harness scope exemption is the intended mechanism, not a workaround. This case anchors that intent — a real harness commit with no spec citation must pass via the scope exemption.

input.commit_message:
feat(harness): add task-parser library

Pure parsing of 03-tasks.md into typed Task[] with citations, deps,
slice. No LLM. Will be reused by controller, builder-input, and
cold-reader-input.

notes: This is the canonical case for the harness scope exemption. If someone tightens the linter to require citations even on harness commits, this case fails — and the methodology breaks (every harness PR would need a fake spec citation, polluting the citation graph). The exemption is intentional and load-bearing for the methodology's separation of feature work from tooling work.
